arguments.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS player_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS distinct_player_ids,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE DATE(debut) IS NOT NULL AND DATE(final_game) IS NOT NULL) AS players_with_both_dates,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE debut = '') AS blank_debuts,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE final_game = '') AS blank_final_games,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE debut IS NULL) AS null_debuts,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE final_game IS NULL) AS null_final_games,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(debut, '') IS NOT NULL AND DATE(debut) IS NULL) AS unparseable_debuts,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(final_game, '') IS NOT NULL AND DATE(final_game) IS NULL) AS unparseable_final_games,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE DATE(final_game) < DATE(debut)) AS reversed_dates
FROM main.player

SELECT CAST(AVG(
    ROUND(ABS(STRFTIME('%Y', final_game) - STRFTIME('%Y', debut)), 2)
  + ROUND(ABS(STRFTIME('%m', final_game) - STRFTIME('%m', debut)) / 12.0, 2)
  + ROUND(ABS(STRFTIME('%d', final_game) - STRFTIME('%d', debut)) / 365.0, 2)
) AS FLOAT) AS average_career_span_years
FROM main.player
LIMIT 1
